/bin/bash -lc "cat > solutions/c.py <<'EOF'
import sys
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]
top = [-1, -1, -1]
out = []
for k, x in enumerate(data[1:]):
    if x > top[0]:
        top[0], top[1], top[2] = x, top[0], top[1]
    elif x > top[1]:
        top[1], top[2] = x, top[1]
    elif x > top[2]:
        top[2] = x
    if k >= 2:
        out.append(str(top[2]))
sys.stdout.write(\"\\n\".join(out))
EOF"
